refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to create a new integer leaf node

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodeCreateFromInteger function generates a new leaf node from an integer value specified by source.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoNodeCreateFromInteger returns a pointer to a new leaf >SilikoNode object with the value passed on success, or NULL if there was a memory error.
